about: Every fitted number left in src/js. 'open' entries are retired by the part named; 'rule' entries are kept by the owner's decision. 'audit' lists files not yet read for fitted numbers. tests/test166.mjs: the lists only shrink.

entries.standsFor: a cam grade's airflow bonus; since build 260 only on rotary and two-stroke engines (a valved engine's estimates read its own integrated filling)
entries.retiredBy: ports as geometry

entries.standsFor: how a hotter cam narrows the low side of the VE bell; the bell is only on rotary and two-stroke engines
entries.retiredBy: ports as geometry

entries.standsFor: idle speed added per cam grade
entries.retiredBy: idle from overlap and residuals. Tried in build 260: Fox, Cheng & Heywood's residual correlation (SAE 931025) with a 30% dilution limit gave 1400 rpm on SPORT and no stable idle on RACE, because the model idles at 0.15 bar of manifold pressure (real 0.3-0.4) and the correlation is outside its range past ~40 deg of overlap. Needs combustion that weakens with dilution first.
